title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: McIlroy on Challenger Series
items.text: Rory McIlroy called the PGA Tour’s new Challenger Series a lateral move for DP World Tour players, advising them to stay on the DP World Tour for bigger events and visibility.

items.headline: No Special Path for LIV Returns
items.text: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp confirmed there will be no fast-track or returning member program for LIV players like Bryson DeChambeau or Jon Rahm, who must re-earn status through existing pathways starting in 2027.
